name: rest
facts: Oreo and Brownie reliably identified, visible and resting for 75 s; camera fresh; no alerts; calm updates enabled; no earlier update this episode.
example_response: Oreo and Brownie are resting. No new alerts.
acceptance: Do not claim sleep or acoustic silence.

name: sleep_supported
facts: Oreo visible with sustained sleep-supporting observations; assessment says appears asleep, not certain.

name: sleep_hidden
facts: Oreo lying still; face hidden; no sleep evidence.
example_response: Oreo is resting, but I can't tell whether he is asleep.

name: partial_coverage
facts: Only Oreo visible and resting; Brownie enrolled but out of view.
example_response: Oreo is resting. Brownie is out of view, so I can't tell about Brownie.

name: stale_camera
facts: Last observation 30 s ago; camera disconnected.
example_response: The camera is disconnected, so I can't check them right now.
acceptance: No current assertion from stale history.

name: empty
facts: Fresh camera; zero dogs detected; no independent evidence of their location.
example_response: I don't see Oreo in the camera view.
acceptance: Do not assert Oreo left the house.

name: repeat_calm
facts: Same resting episode already announced 2 min ago; no change.

name: dnd_calm
facts: Fresh supported resting episode; DND enabled.
acceptance: Log candidate if useful; do not speak.

name: owner_speaking
facts: Resting update eligible; owner currently speaking.
acceptance: Suppress or expire casual update; do not interrupt.

name: danger_priority
facts: Danger alert pending for Oreo near high-tier hazard; casual rest update also queued; DND off.
example_response: Oreo may be near a dangerous object. Please check now.
acceptance: Danger first; discard conflicting calm update; no claim of ingestion.

name: transition
facts: Oreo rested 5 min, now reliably walking for several observations; transition updates enabled; cooldown satisfied.
example_response: Oreo is up and walking now.
acceptance: Do not infer a desire for food or a walk.

name: followup
facts: Recent subject Oreo; continuous observed rest duration 4 min; current observations fresh.
user: How long has he been there?
example_response: Oreo has been resting there for about four minutes.
acceptance: Resolve only the unambiguous recent subject.

name: ambiguous
facts: Oreo and Brownie both visible; no recent subject.
example_response: Do you mean Oreo or Brownie?

name: taglish
facts: Oreo reliably lying on bed; requested language Taglish.

name: unknown_object
example_response: Oreo is chewing something, but I can't identify it. Please check.
acceptance: Do not invent plastic, food or a battery.

name: conversation_correction
facts: Owner corrects prior description; no explicit teaching request.
example_response: Thanks for correcting me. I'll describe him as resting, not asleep.
acceptance: Do not save examples or replace future camera facts with permanent awake state.

name: social
facts: No dog-status question; owner greets Bantay; no active alert. Confirmed owner profile name: John.
acceptance: Short greeting; owner name must come from confirmed profile.

name: daily_gap
facts: Only 10 min of activity history exists; no full-day episode log.
user: What did they do all day?
example_response: I only have the last ten minutes of activity, so I cannot summarize the whole day.
acceptance: State coverage; no fabricated all-day summary.

name: stop
facts: Bantay speaking a casual answer; stop control activated; danger alert absent.
acceptance: Cancel current audio/generation; no delayed replay. Needs interruption integration.
